service.description: Start a run of agentId (default assist) for the current user on a surface (default drawer), in a conversation of theirs or a new one. While the conversation has an active run, the message goes to that run as input instead (queued true), which it folds in at its next step. The same clientRequestId again returns the run it made. The run works in the background on the agent pool.

parameter.name: surface
parameter.description: drawer, chat or tui; a2a, mcp and job need AgentAdmin. The tools always run as the current user.

parameter.name: tail
parameter.description: The context block of this message

service.description: Ask a run of the current user to stop. A run that holds no worker ends Canceled now; one working stops at its next check (a service call already running finishes). The text streamed so far is kept.
Input for a run of the current user: a message (steering, folded in at the next step), an answer to its question, a decision or a remote reply. A paused run resumes with it.
The stored events of a run of the current user after afterSeq (at most 1000), with the last sequence and the run's status: the catch-up of a client that polls.

The current user's decision on an approval of theirs: approve (with edited arguments for a service or tool call), reject with feedback (the agent's next task), or edit (Edit in screen: the user's page gets the proposed values and the user saves it; the run waits for that save). Taken only from an interactive session: a browser session authenticated by its cookie whose transition presented the session token, or the terminal. A header-authenticated request (Basic, api_key, login_key), an agent's own screen session, agent-apps and internal code are refused; another user's approval is not found; a second decision, an expired approval and one whose run no longer waits are refused. The run resumes with the decision.

parameter.name: arguments
parameter.description: Edited arguments of a service or tool call (approve only); a screen write is edited in the screen

service.description: The effects of a pending approval of the current user, run in the sim overlay as the user: the rows it would create, change or delete, against production, or why it failed in the preview. Kept on the approval. Only a server with the sim overlay can preview.

An approval of the current user as its card shows it: the summary, the changes (current against proposed), the record, the status, the expiry, whether it may be edited in the screen and previewed, and the preview and result when there are. Another user's approval is not found.

The current user left a hand-off (Edit in screen) without saving, as when the drawer navigates away: the watch is abandoned and the run goes on with that. Only from an interactive session, only the watch's user.

The agentRef of an agent's chat member (plans/LLM-A2A-Assist.md 4.13; ChatServices.deliver#AgentMessage calls it for each message of the room): the message is read from the room, and a message that mentions the agent, any message of a direct room with it, or the sender's next message in a thread where the agent works for them starts a run of the agent (the AgentDefinition whose chatUserId is agentUserId) as the sender, on the chat surface, in the conversation of the room, the thread and the sender. Messages of agents start nothing. The reply, the approval and question cards and the typing status go to the room as the run works. The same message again starts no second run. It trusts none of its parameters but the room, the message's eventSeq and the agent member (the sender is the message's), so any caller may hand it a message, and the run is always the sender's; not callable remotely.

The current user's press of a button on an agent's card in a chat room (content.assist of message eventSeq): approve or reject an approval, which any human user who may post in the room may do (answered question 12; the write still runs as the person who asked), or answer a question (choice or text), which only that person may. Taken only from an interactive browser session by its cookie with the session token, as decide#AgentApproval: a header login, an agent's context and internal code are refused, and an agent member or the chat or run-as user of any agent never decides. Edit in screen is the requester's, from the drawer.

parameter.name: decision
parameter.description: approve or reject, for an approval

service.description: What a user-facts provider implements (plans/LLM-A2A-Assist.md 7.6; crates/moqui-core/src/llm/facts.rs): facts about the user for the prompt of a new conversation with an agent, such as the active organization, and the organization's instructions. A component names its implementation in a user-facts element of the llm-facade conf. It runs under the read fence, so it may only read; a label the framework or an earlier provider gave keeps its first value.

parameter.name: factList
parameter.description: Maps of label and value, one line each

parameter.name: instructions
parameter.description: The organization's instructions (at most 800 characters are used)
